rules.text: Refunds can be expected in 3-5 business days after return in store.
rules.quote: Refunds can be expected in 3-5 business days.

rules.text: Returns sent by mail are processed in 8-12 business days and refunds can be expected 3-5 business days after processing.
rules.quote: Returns are processed in 8-12 business days and refunds can be expected 3-5 business days after processing.

rules.text: For Marketplace items sold by third-party sellers, expect refunds within 10-14 business days of shipping the return, including transit and processing time.
rules.quote: For Marketplace items sold by third-party sellers, expect refunds within 10-14 business days of shipping the return, including transit and processing time.

rules.text: If no record of sale is available, personal identification is required and refund will be provided on a Nordstrom gift card at current price.
rules.quote: If we choose to provide a refund and no record of sale is available, we'll ask for personal identification and a refund will be provided at the current price on a Nordstrom gift card.

rules.text: Balsam Hill returns/exchanges are accepted within 30 days of purchase or prior to December 25, whichever comes first.
rules.quote: Returns/exchanges are accepted within 30 days of purchase or prior to December 25 (whichever comes first).

rules.text: Nordstrom will not accept Balsam Hill products in stores or by mail.
rules.quote: Nordstrom will not accept Balsam Hill products in stores or by mail.

rules.text: Car seats and bases can only be returned in their original, unopened boxes.
rules.quote: Car seats and bases can only be returned in their original, unopened boxes.

rules.text: Fine jewelry cannot be returned by mail and must be returned to a Nordstrom store with a Fine Jewelry department with order confirmation or credit card used.
rules.quote: For your protection, fine jewelry cannot be returned by mail. Please return fine jewelry to any Nordstrom store that has a Fine Jewelry department. Bring your order confirmation (email or digital receipt) and/or the credit card used when you placed the order.

rules.text: Marketplace products are not eligible for exchanges, price adjustments, or expedited shipping services.
rules.quote: Please note that Marketplace products are not eligible for exchanges, price adjustments, or expedited shipping services.

rules.quote: Returns/exchanges are accepted within 30 days of purchase or prior to December 25 (whichever comes first).
